tasks.label: 组装星灯旅店交付包
tasks.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = '${workspaceFolder}\StarlightInn'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$root\play
ative" -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$root\qa
ative-build\StarlightAzure.exe" "$root
ative\StarlightAzure.exe" -Force; Copy-Item "$root\qa
ative-build\StarlightAzure.exe" "$root\play
ative\StarlightAzure.exe" -Force; foreach ($doc in @('README.md','API.md','AAD_SETUP.md')) { Copy-Item "$root\$doc" "$root\play\$doc" -Force }; if (-not (Test-Path "$root\play\azure-settings.json")) { Copy-Item "$root\azure-settings.json" "$root\play\azure-settings.json" }; Compress-Archive -Path "$root\play" -DestinationPath "$root\StarlightInn-Windows.zip" -Force; Get-ChildItem "$root\play" -Recurse -File | Format-Table Name,Length; Get-Item "$root\StarlightInn-Windows.zip" | Format-Table Name,Length
